title: Merit Rewarded, Turmoil Arising
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji was preparing to respond, a mysterious figure quietly appeared at the gathering

text.content:
Tianqing Sect, Merit Hall.

At the third mark of the Chen hour, the morning bell resonated melodiously through the solemn hall. Over a hundred Inner Disciples stood in lines on either side, Peak Elders seated on the high platform, while the central main seat remained empty—the Sect Master was in seclusion, and today the Fifth Elder presided in his stead.

Chen Ji stood at the end of the队列, dressed in a plain white Servant Disciple robe, utterly unremarkable. Gazes from surrounding disciples swept over him occasionally, carrying curiosity and contempt. Word of his legendary comeback in the Secret Realm as a '废物' had spread throughout the sect, yet few truly accepted his achievements.

'A废物 can accomplish deeds?' someone sneered quietly. 'He just got lucky.'

Chen Ji acted as if he heard nothing, eyes lowered, his heart as calm as still water. Mo Xiansheng's voice echoed in his mind: 'Boy, the Fifth Elder has been watching you closely today. Be careful.'

The Fifth Elder cleared his throat, his aged voice reverberating through the hall: 'Today we assess merit and distribute rewards. First, each Peak will report their Secret Realm gains, then we shall evaluate and allocate based on merit.'

His gaze swept over Chen Ji intentionally, a meaningful smile playing at the corner of his mouth.

Chen Ji's heart stirred. That old fox's eyes were sizing him up like a lamb awaiting slaughter. He remained composed, quietly activating the Tianji Record—the fragment warmed slightly—three breaths later, the vision materialized: the Fifth Elder rising, publicly reading aloud a letter of accusation, charging him with collusion and treason against the sect.

Mo Xiansheng coldly snorted: 'Here they come. Seems someone can't sit still any longer.'

Chen Ji inwardly smirked. He had anticipated this—their remarkable performance in the Secret Realm had碍了眼. An accusation? Fine. Let's see what tricks they have up their sleeves.

However, the predicted scene arrived faster than Chen Ji had imagined.

Just as the Peak reports were concluding, the Fifth Elder suddenly raised his hand: 'Hold on. This Elder has a matter to announce publicly.'

He drew from his sleeve a letter sealed with black wax, his voice suddenly rising: 'Someone has anonymously accused—'

His gaze like a blade, he pierced directly toward Chen Ji: 'Outer Disciple Chen Ji, in the Secret Realm colluded with the Demonic Path Holy Sect, acted as a mole, intending to harm our Tianqing Sect!'

The words fell like a thunderclap, shocking the entire hall.

Chen Ji's eyes slightly narrowed, yet his expression remained unchanged. Here it comes—faster and fiercer than anticipated. He internally冷笑, outwardly displaying perfect terror and confusion, his acting impeccable.

dialogue.content:
The Fifth Elder raised the letter high, his voice sharp: 'This accusation letter details how Chen Ji secretly corresponded with a Demonic Path woman, how he deliberately released Demonic Path scouts at a critical moment, and how he hoarded Secret Realm treasures without reporting them!'

He pressed on relentlessly: 'Chen Ji! What do you have to say for yourself!'

Silence gripped the hall. All eyes focused on the white-robed youth.

Chen Ji slowly raised his head, a faint cold gleam flickering in his eyes before he resumed his timorous appearance, voice trembling slightly: 'Fi... Fifth Elder, wh... what is this about? Your disciple is wronged!'

text.content:
'Wronged?' The Fifth Elder冷笑, handing the letter to a nearby attendant disciple. 'This Elder shall read it aloud for all—Upon investigation, Outer Servant Chen Ji, despite his meager cultivation, repeatedly encountered extraordinary fortunes, which must be suspicious. In the Secret Realm, the Demonic Path Saint Woman Ye Qing publicly defended him—this abnormal behavior is certainly not ordinary...'

Chen Ji listened quietly, his mind rapidly calculating. The Fifth Elder's rhetoric seemed righteous, yet was full of holes—if he truly were a Demonic Path mole, why would he have risked his life to protect fellow disciples in the Secret Realm? This was clearly a case of fabricating charges.

Mo Xiansheng whispered: 'Boy, this is a deadly trap. Explaining yourself means appearing guilty, not explaining means accepting the accusation.'

Chen Ji's lips slightly curved upward. Is that so? Perhaps not.

Just then, the side door of the hall suddenly swung open, and a cold voice rang out: 'Fifth Elder, your words are misguided.'

Everyone turned to look. A woman in a blue silk dress approached slowly, her brows like distant mountains, her eyes like cold stars—it was Su Qingyao, the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow.

Her gaze swept over Chen Ji with some examination, then turned to the Fifth Elder: 'During the Secret Realm incident, Brother Chen Ji risked his life to protect several Outer Disciples—this was witnessed by many disciples. If he were a Demonic Path mole, why would he have done such a thing?'

The Fifth Elder frowned: 'Su Senior Fellow, this is a matter between this Elder and Chen Ji.'

Su Qingyao replied coolly: 'Sect matters are everyone's matters.'

choice.prompt: The Fifth Elder pressed relentlessly while Su Qingyao spoke out for justice, the situation reaching a deadlock. As Chen Ji, how will you respond to this sudden crisis?

choices.description: Continue feigning terror and innocence, let Su Qingyao shield you, while secretly observing the Fifth Elder's hidden forces and waiting for the right moment to counterattack.
choices.visible_reward: Preserve your trump cards, let the enemy reveal more weaknesses
choices.risk_hint: If Su Qingyao is also targeted, you might implicate her

dialogue.content: Chen Ji slightly lowered his head, voice trembling: 'Your disciple... your disciple truly doesn't know how to defend himself, I only ask that the Elder investigate thoroughly.' He secretly glanced at Su Qingyao, eyes filled with 'gratitude.'

choices.description: Immediately produce evidence to refute, point out the numerous holes in the Fifth Elder's 'evidence,' directly confront the enemy.
choices.visible_cost: Completely break with the Fifth Elder
choices.visible_reward: Clear your name before everyone, intimidate the villains

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly straightened his spine, a brilliant gleam flashing in his eyes: 'Fifth Elder, your disciple has one thing he doesn't understand—regarding the 'Demonic Path Saint Woman Ye Qing' mentioned in this accusation letter, how did you come to know her identity?'

choices.description: Don't refute directly, instead guide public opinion, redirect the spear toward the Fifth Elder's hidden connections with the Xuanwu Sect, use other forces to resolve the crisis.
choices.visible_reward: Kill two birds with one stone, simultaneously weaken the Fifth Elder's faction
choices.risk_hint: If exposed, you may offend both sides

dialogue.content: Chen Ji looked around, his voice calm: "Fellow senior brothers and sisters, I do indeed know Ye Qing—but that was a life-and-death battle, not some secret collusion. I am curious, though: how did this letter of accusation know the details of the secret realm so precisely?"

text.content: The Fifth Elder's expression slightly darkened, but he did not fly into a rage. Standing with hands behind his back, he looked down at Chen Ji: "In consideration of your youth and ignorance, this one gives you a chance. If you truthfully confess your dealings with the Demonic Path, this one may spare your life; if you persist in your folly——" His voice shifted, suddenly ice-cold: "Do not blame this one for showing no mercy to a fellow disciple!" A formless pressure radiated from him, pressing down on Chen Ji's shoulders like something tangible. This was the full force of a Foundation Building Late Stage cultivator, and for a Qi Refining menial servant, it was as if Mount Tai was crushing down! Chen Ji's face turned slightly pale, his knees trembling slightly, as if he might collapse at any moment. Yet he gritted his teeth, refusing to bow his spine.

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind, tinged with gravity: "Kid, the old bastard is getting serious. Someone powerful is backing him, and he wants to take this opportunity to crush you completely." Chen Ji sneered in his heart, but on the surface displayed only panic: "F-Fifth Elder, please calm your anger, the disciple truly knows nothing..."

text.content: Su Qingyao's brow furrowed tightly. Just as she was about to speak, the Fifth Elder abruptly raised his hand, and a spiritual force scroll materialized out of thin air, floating in the center of the hall. "This is the evidence this one obtained from the accuser." The Fifth Elder said coldly, "It records the specific times, locations, and the whereabouts of the secret realm's ultimate treasure that Chen Ji secretly hoarded—the Nine Heavens Profound Jade!" The entire hall erupted in uproar. Chen Ji's pupils slightly contracted. Nine Heavens Profound Jade? What was that? He had never seen it. His mind raced rapidly—this was clearly someone forging evidence to frame and frame him! The Fifth Elder's gaze was like a venomous snake, staring fixedly at him: "Chen Ji, what else do you have to say?"

Just then, a commotion suddenly arose outside the hall. A disciple rushed in, kneeling on one knee: "Report—Han Lie, the number one prodigy of the Xuanwu Sect, requests an audience, saying he has urgent matters to report to the Fifth Elder!" A flash of concealed joy flickered in the Fifth Elder's eyes, then returned to calm: "Let him in." Chen Ji's heart sank. The Tianji Record's foresight had come true—Han Lie's arrival was the Fifth Elder's hidden trump card. He knew today's matter would not end so easily. Mo Xiansheng whispered: "Kid, the visitor means trouble. Han Lie may be a reckless fool, but behind him stands the entire Xuanwu Sect. Do not underestimate him." Chen Ji nodded slightly, the panic in his eyes gradually replaced by an abyss-like coldness.

dialogue.content: At the hall entrance, a tall figure strode in with great vigor. Han Lie wore black combat attire, emanating a fierce aura. His tiger-like eyes swept across the entire venue before finally landing on Chen Ji, the corners of his mouth curling into a disdainful arc. "So this is the废物?" His voice thundered like a roar, "I thought he'd be some legendary figure with extraordinary powers, but turns out he's just a Qi Refining ant!" He strode up to Chen Ji, looking down at him from above: "废物, let me ask you—during the secret realm incident, how did you kill my three Xuanwu Sect disciples?"

choice.prompt: Han Lie publicly made trouble, questioning Chen Ji about killing the Xuanwu Sect disciples. The crowd grew indignant, and the situation grew increasingly unfavorable for Chen Ji.

choices.description: Maintain silence, wait for Han Lie to reveal more flaws, let the facts speak for themselves, and let the opposing side crumble on their own.
choices.visible_reward: Let Han Lie expose more tells, guide the public opinion to reverse
choices.risk_hint: If no one speaks up for you, you may be seized on the spot

dialogue.content: Chen Ji took a step back, whispering: "Senior Brother Han, regarding that matter, the disciple was also forced to counter-attack. If there was any offense, please forgive me." His posture was extremely humble, as if genuinely afraid.

choices.description: Directly point out that Han Lie's claims are false. That day, it was he who initiated the sneak attack. The so-called "disciple killing Xuanwu Sect disciples" is complete inversion of truth.
choices.visible_reward: Prove your innocence before everyone, and ruthlessly slap Han Lie's face
choices.risk_hint: Without evidence, you may be counter-attacked and suffer even more

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly raised his head, staring directly into Han Lie's eyes: "Senior Brother Han, that day it was you who first launched a sneak attack on our Tianqing Sect disciples. The disciple merely defended myself. This can be testified by numerous Tianqing Sect disciples present at the scene!"

choices.description: Do not respond directly, but steer the topic toward the hidden relationship between Han Lie and the Fifth Elder, making everyone suspect this is a coordinated conspiracy against you.
choices.visible_reward: Kill two birds with one stone, dismantle their alliance, and make the opposing side panic
choices.risk_hint: If exposed, you may suffer an even worse death

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly let out a light laugh: 'Han-shixiong arrived just in time. The accusation letter just finished being read, and here you are. I wonder how Han-shixiong got this news?'

text.content:
Upon hearing this, Han Lie flew into a rage and grabbed Chen Ji's collar: 'You waste, how dare you make excuses!'
At this moment, Su Qingyao suddenly spoke: 'Han-gongzi, this is the Tianqing Sect Great Hall, not your Xuanwu Sect!'
Han Lie coldly snorted, releasing his grip but still looking aggressive: 'Su Zhongxi, I respect you as Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, but if you want to protect this waste—'
'Fifth Elder.' Su Qingyao interrupted, turning to the high platform. 'What Han-gongzi said is hard to verify. According to sect rules, this matter should be handed over to the Law Enforcement Hall for a thorough investigation, not judged here publicly.'
The Fifth Elder narrowed his eyes, about to speak, when Han Lie suddenly took out a jade slip from his chest: 'No need to investigate! I have a jade slip with recordings of that day's events in the secret realm—clearly showing how this waste slaughtered our Xuanwu Sect disciples!'

The atmosphere inside the great hall suddenly tensed to the extreme.
Chen Ji stared at the jade slip in Han Lie's hand, a cold smile forming in his heart. He naturally knew what was recorded in that jade slip—it wasn't footage of him killing anyone, but a falsified fabrication. The Xuanwu Sect had clearly prepared for this day for a long time.
Mo Xiansheng whispered: 'Boy, if you let them play this jade slip in public, you'll be completely at a disadvantage.'
Chen Ji gave a slight nod. He knew it was time to reveal some of his trump cards.
He took a deep breath and suddenly spoke: 'Wait!'
His voice wasn't loud, but it clearly carried through the entire hall. Everyone turned to look at him, only to see him slowly raise his head, the fear and timidity in his eyes already vanished, replaced by a chilling calm.
'Han-shixiong wants to play the jade slip, I have no objection. But before playing it, there's something I'd like the Fifth Elder to examine.'

The Fifth Elder frowned: 'What is it?'
Chen Ji took out a jade slip from his chest and said indifferently: 'This is a recording I accidentally made while in the secret realm. It records Han-gongzi's secret conversation with a mysterious figure—'
His gaze swept across Han Lie's suddenly stiff face, a cold smile curling at the corner of his mouth: 'And how they planned to frame me, as well as—the role the Fifth Elder played in this conspiracy.'
The entire hall erupted in uproar!
Han Lie's face instantly turned ashen. He stepped forward sharply: 'You waste, how dare you make such unfounded accusations!'
Chen Ji stepped back, gripping the jade slip in his hand, his voice calm: 'If Han-gongzi has a clear conscience, why be so agitated? Whether this jade slip is real or fake can be determined simply by playing it.'

The atmosphere in the great hall instantly reversed.
The disciples who had been pointing at Chen Ji began whispering among themselves, their gazes shifting between Han Lie, the Fifth Elder, and Chen Ji.
The Fifth Elder's expression grew extremely gloomy. He never expected that this servant disciple, dismissed as a废物, would still have such a trump card hidden up his sleeve.
Mo Xiansheng whispered: 'Well done, boy. But this jade slip is just some irrelevant content you randomly copied. The real killing blow hasn't been revealed yet.'
Chen Ji inwardly laughed. Yes, this jade slip contained no evidence of Han Lie colluding with the Fifth Elder. He was simply gambling—gambling that Han Lie, with a guilty conscience, wouldn't dare verify it publicly.

Han Lie stared fixedly at the jade slip in Chen Ji's hand, veins bulging on his forehead. Of course he didn't dare let anyone play it—because he had indeed had secret conversations with the Fifth Elder. Although Chen Ji couldn't possibly know the specific content, who knew what other trump cards this废物 had up his sleeve?
Just as the two sides were at a stalemate, the Fifth Elder suddenly spoke: 'Enough!'
His voice was ice-cold, carrying the irresistible authority: 'Today's matter is full of doubts. Whether Chen Ji's jade slip is genuine and whether Han Lie's accusations are true both require thorough investigation. Before the truth is revealed—'
His gaze fell on Chen Ji, meaningful: 'Chen Ji will remain in the sect temporarily and not go out, awaiting investigation.'
This was clearly a delaying tactic. Chen Ji inwardly冷笑—house arrest? Fine, that just gives him time to make arrangements.

Su Qingyao stepped forward: 'Fifth Elder, about this matter—'
'Su Zhongxi.' The Fifth Elder interrupted her. 'I know you and Chen Ji share the same lineage, but sect rules cannot be broken. This matter will be handled by the Law Enforcement Hall. You don't need to intervene.'
Su Qingyao's brow furrowed tightly. She glanced at Chen Ji, her gaze carrying a hint of scrutiny—this disciple she had never quite understood, the cunning and depth he was now revealing far exceeded her imagination.
Chen Ji felt her gaze and slightly lowered his head, assuming a submissive appearance. But in his heart, he was quickly calculating: Su Qingyao had already noticed his abnormalities... This woman was far more dangerous than Han Lie.

'Well said, "temporarily remain in the sect and not go out."'
Just at this moment, a senile voice rang out from the rear of the great hall, like the evening drum and morning bells, shocking everyone present.
Everyone turned back, only to see an elderly man with white hair and beard slowly walking out. He wore a gray daoist robe, his features gaunt, but his eyes sparkled with brilliance.
'It's the Supreme Elder!' someone exclaimed in alarm.
The Supreme Elder Lingxuzi, in charge of the Tianqing Sect Disciplinary Hall, enforced the law strictly and impartially, enjoying extremely high prestige in the sect.
He slowly walked to the center of the great hall, his gaze sweeping across the Fifth Elder, Han Lie, and finally landing on Chen Ji. His voice carried no emotion: 'I was listening in the side hall for a while just now. The five of you each insist on your own version, but none can produce ironclad evidence. Since that's the case—'

Lingxuzi's gaze fell on Chen Ji, nodding slightly: 'You child, you do have some courage. However—'
He turned sharply, his voice suddenly stern: 'Regardless of the truth, that day in the secret realm, someone did indeed die at your hands. This, you cannot deny.'
Chen Ji's heart tightened. This old man was even harder to deal with than the Fifth Elder.
'So, the old man's proposal was clear—a decisive duel would settle the matter. Three days from now, they'd face each other on the sect's debate platform, with everything hanging in the balance. Victory meant complete vindication, while defeat would mean no holds barred combat.
The hall erupted in stunned murmurs. Everyone knew the enormous gap between a Qi Refining cultivator and a Foundation Building cultivator—this was essentially a death sentence.

dialogue.content:
Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out in his mind, heavy with gravity: 'Boy, this is a yang scheme. If you refuse, you're admitting guilt; if you accept, it's a必死之局.'
Chen Ji's gaze flickered slightly, but a subtle smile tugged at the corner of his mouth.
He stepped forward, clasping his hands toward Lingxuzi: 'This disciple... is willing to accept the challenge.'
The entire hall erupted in shock.
Han Lie froze for a moment, then burst into laughter: 'Hahaha! Good! Good! Good! You waste, you have guts! Three days from now, I'll make you die a clear death!'

text.content:
In the great hall, undercurrents churned.
The Fifth Elder's lips curled slightly upward, a hint of triumph flickering in his eyes. Han Lie's smile grew even more unbridled, as if he could already see Chen Ji's blood splattering across the debate platform.
Yet Chen Ji simply stood quietly in place, his drooping eyelids concealing the cold light burning deep within his eyes.
Three days... that would be enough.
Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded again: 'Boy, have you thought this through?'
Chen Ji offered no response. He merely gave a slight nod, already calculating in his heart—all sorts of schemes were taking shape in his mind.
Just then, a sudden commotion erupted at the great hall's entrance. Chen Ji glanced sideways to catch a glimpse of a black-cloaked figure silently appearing outside the hall's gates, quietly observing everything within.
It was a familiar face—Ye Qing.
